problems.title: Format sizes
problems.statement: A 100,000 × 100,000 matrix with 1,000,000 non-zeros, FP32 values, 32-bit indices.
hints: COO: row, col, value per entry.

problems.title: ELL padding

parts.prompt: Hybrid with ELL width 10: entries in COO?

problems.solution: 500,000 slots for 14,900 values: 97.0% padding. Hybrid ELL(10) + COO puts 4,900 overflow entries in COO.

problems.title: Scalar CSR divergence
problems.statement: A warp handles 32 rows with lengths 1, 1, …, 1 and one row of 64.
problems.solution: 64 iterations, 4.6% efficiency: why scalar CSR suffers on skewed rows.

problems.title: Vector CSR waste

parts.prompt: Lane efficiency for rows of 8 non-zeros, in %?

problems.solution: 25% for 8-entry rows; 78% for 100 (4 iterations of 32). Use 4 or 8 lanes per row for short rows.

problems.title: SpMV time bound
problems.statement: CSR SpMV with 10⁸ non-zeros, FP32, on 1 TB/s; assume x reads hit cache.
problems.solution: 0.8 GB, 0.8 ms, 250 GFLOP/s: SpMV runs at about 2–5% of a modern GPU's FP32 peak, all of it bandwidth.

problems.title: Merge-based balance
problems.statement: Split nnz = 10⁶ non-zeros evenly over 10,000 threads; rows located by binary search over rowPtr (100,001 entries).
problems.solution: 100 non-zeros each, 17 search steps: perfect balance however skewed the rows.

problems.title: JDS

options: length, so warps get rows of similar length

problems.solution: Sorting rows by length groups similar rows into warps; a permutation maps results back.

problems.title: 2:4 sparsity
problems.statement: Ampere's structured sparsity: in every group of 4 weights, 2 are zero.
problems.solution: Half the values (plus 2-bit indices) and up to 2× math throughput, because the pattern is fixed and hardware-friendly, unlike arbitrary sparsity.

problems.title: The x gather
problems.statement: Vector CSR, rows of 64 random columns over an n-vector x.

parts.prompt: Sectors per warp load of x with random columns (32 lanes)?

options: Reorder the matrix (e.g. RCM) so columns cluster

problems.solution: About 32 sectors per warp load; reordering for bandwidth reduction clusters columns so gathers share sectors and hit cache.

problems.title: Pick a format

parts.prompt: Building a matrix incrementally from unordered (i, j, v) triples
Rows of almost identical length, GPU SpMV

problems.solution: COO to build, ELL for regular rows, CSR as the general format.
